story: The Egyptian Vulture (Neophron percnopterus) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Accipitridae family. It is most commonly observed in Semi-arid/arid regions; open landscapes; cliffs; mountainous areas; steppes; savannahs; and plains, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Endangered (EN) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Egyptian Vulture is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Egyptian Vulture into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
